name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Reroute.two_pass_cross_rank_le
title: Two-pass cross-partition rank bound (CVW18 section 9.3.2 for c = 2)
statement: Over a field, for u, v vectors indexed by a finite type of size t and matrix-valued maps P1, P2 of the X-variables and Q1, Q2 of the Y-variables, the X-by-Y matrix with entries u * P1 x * Q1 y * P2 x * Q2 y * v has rank at most t^3.
